# Rfishmorph

**Morphological traits, landmarks and quality control for the FISHMORPH
database.**

Rfishmorph collects the FISHMORPH routines originally developed inside
`intraitR` into a stand-alone package dedicated to the FISHMORPH
morphological database of freshwater fishes (Brosse et al., 2021). It
reconstructs the 21 FISHMORPH landmarks, computes the 11 body segments
and the 9 dimensionless ratios, standardizes landmark geometry and
enforces the FISHMORPH digitizing conventions, projects specimens into
the FISHMORPH functional trait space, and provides visualization and
quality-control tools. It also offers a guided workflow to add new
species, using `rfishbase` to validate taxonomy and build a global
freshwater fish list.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
remotes::install_github("FunTraits/Rfishmorph")
```

The core functions depend only on base R. Optional features use
`ggplot2` (plots), `rfishbase` (taxonomy / freshwater list),
`readxl`/`writexl` (Excel I/O) and `shiny`/`jpeg`/`png` (interactive
reconstruction). After editing the roxygen comments, regenerate the help
pages with `devtools::document()`.

## The FISHMORPH scheme

|  |  |  |
|----|----|----|
| **21 landmarks** | anatomical points digitized on a lateral photo | `fishmorph_schema()$landmark_labels` |
| **11 segments** | `Bl, Bd, Hd, Eh, Mo, PFi, PFl, Ed, Jl, CPd, CFd` | [`fishmorph_segment_names()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_segment_names.md) |
| **9 ratios** | `BEl, VEp, REs, OGp, RMl, BLs, PFv, PFs, CPt` | [`fishmorph_ratio_names()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_ratio_names.md) |

Ratios are dimensionless (each is a quotient of two segments of the same
specimen), so they are scale-invariant and comparable across studies.

## Typical workflows

### 1. Measure a specimen

``` r

library(Rfishmorph)

lm  <- read_landmarks_csv(
  system.file("extdata", "example_landmarks.csv", package = "Rfishmorph"))
seg <- fishmorph_segments(lm, scale_cm = 1)   # 11 segments (cm)
rat <- fishmorph_ratios(seg)                  # 9 ratios
plot_landmarks(lm, specimen = 1)              # ggplot of points + segments
```

### 2. Functional trait space

``` r

ref <- load_fishmorph_reference()             # bundled 400-species sample
ts  <- fishmorph_trait_space(ref, groups = ref$Order)   # frozen PCA
plot_trait_space(ts,style = "none",arrows = T)                          # PCA with hulls + loadings
```

Project focal specimens into the global FISHMORPH morphospace and draw
the reference density heatmap with per-species footprints (the intraitR
figure):

``` r

# `specimens` = focal individuals from fishmorph_ratios(); reference = database
proj <- project_fishmorph(specimens, reference = ref)
plot(proj, style = "hull")                    # density heatmap + species hulls
plot(proj, style = "hull", arrows = TRUE)     # add trait loading arrows
plot(proj, style = "spider", itv_reference = TRUE)
```

### 3. Quality control: segments vs landmarks

``` r

# does a workbook's published morphology match its digitized landmarks?
cmp <- compare_segments_landmarks(landmarks = lm, published = published_segments,
                                  id_col = "Genus.species")
summary(cmp)
plot_segment_landmark_agreement(cmp, type = "scatter")
plot_segment_landmark_agreement(cmp, type = "bar")

check_infinite_ratios(rat)          # zero-denominator / outlier ratios
check_geometry_conventions(lm)      # departure from the 5 digitizing rules
```

### 4. Add a new species

``` r

# resolve the name against FishBase (needs rfishbase)
validate_species_names(c("Salmo trutta", "Esox_lucius"))

# build a schema-compliant record, then append it to the reference
rec <- new_fishmorph_species(
  "Genus novus",
  segments = list(Bl = 10, Bd = 3.2, Hd = 2.4, Eh = 1.1, Mo = 1.6, PFi = 1.9,
                  PFl = 2.1, Ed = 0.6, Jl = 1.3, CPd = 1.0, CFd = 3.0),
  family = "Cyprinidae", order = "Cypriniformes")
ref2 <- add_fishmorph_species(ref, rec)

# a global list of freshwater fishes (needs rfishbase)
fw <- freshwater_fish_list()
```

### 5. Digitize photographs, store them safely, explore the space

The two ends of the workflow are Shiny applications. **Photographs stay
on your machine**: only their file name and pixel dimensions are ever
recorded.

``` r

# --- digitize -------------------------------------------------------------
# Three switchable queues: species without landmarks ("reconstruct"), already
# landmarked species to review ("correct"), and brand-new photographs ("new").
launch_fishmorph_digitizer(
  xlsx_path     = "FishMORPH/FISHMORPH_PUBLI_9556sp.xlsx",
  photo_dir     = "FishMORPH/Photos utilisées",   # stays local
  new_photo_dir = "FishMORPH/Photos nouvelles",   # stays local
  operator      = "AT",
  mode          = "new")

# --- consolidate ----------------------------------------------------------
jdir <- "FishMORPH/landmark_journal"
fm_journal_status(jdir)                       # what is actually in there?
base <- fishmorph_consolidate(jdir)           # wide table, one row per key
qc   <- fishmorph_journal_qc(jdir)            # never-verified points, gaps

# --- database + archives (needs DBI + duckdb) -----------------------------
res <- fishmorph_build_db(jdir,
         db_path    = "FishMORPH/fishmorph.duckdb",
         export_dir = "FishMORPH/exports")     # Parquet + CSV
subset(res$issues, severite == "erreur")

con <- fishmorph_db_connect("FishMORPH/fishmorph.duckdb")
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "FROM v_ratios WHERE species = ?",
                params = list("Coilia.nasus"))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# --- explore --------------------------------------------------------------
launch_fishmorph_space()                      # embedded 9556-species dataset
```

## Data architecture

Digitizing never overwrites what is already written:

    photographs --> append-only journal --> DuckDB database --> Parquet / CSV
    (local only)    (source of truth,       (constraints,       (citable archive)
                     one TSV per session)    views, SQL)

The journal is the only durable layer. The database and the workbook are
**derived artefacts**:
[`fishmorph_build_db()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_build_db.md)
rebuilds them from scratch in seconds, which is what makes it safe to
keep them in a synchronised folder. Never write into the database by
hand — the next rebuild will erase it.

Each point carries a `status` that a wide coordinate table cannot
express: `placed` (clicked), `seeded` (**still at its seed position,
never checked**), `derived` (computed: 8, 9, 11, 15, 23), `na` (declared
unmeasurable). In `reconstruct` mode a `seeded` point still sits exactly
where the input segments put it, so validating its ratio against the
FISHMORPH envelope is circular — filter on `status` before any
validation analysis.

## Round-trip guarantee

[`reconstruct_fishmorph_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/reconstruct_fishmorph_landmarks.md)
is the inverse of
[`fishmorph_segments()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_segments.md):
the free placement parameters change only *where* landmarks sit, never
the segment *lengths*.
[`check_reconstruction_roundtrip()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/check_reconstruction_roundtrip.md)
verifies that `segments -> landmarks -> segments` returns the input to
machine precision.

## Reference

Brosse, S., Charpin, N., Su, G., Toussaint, A., Herrera-R, G.A.,
Tedesco, P.A. & Villeger, S. (2021). FISHMORPH: A global database on
morphological traits of freshwater fishes. *Global Ecology and
Biogeography*, 30, 2330–2336. <https://doi.org/10.1111/geb.13395>

## Note on provenance

The FISHMORPH functions here mirror the `intraitR` implementations
([`fishmorph_segments()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_segments.md),
[`fishmorph_ratios()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_ratios.md),
[`standardize_geometry()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/standardize_geometry.md),
[`correct_geometry_conventions()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/correct_geometry_conventions.md),
[`project_fishmorph()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/project_fishmorph.md)
/ `trait_space()`), so the two packages remain interoperable while
FISHMORPH support migrates out of `intraitR`. Objects of class
`intrait_landmarks` are accepted throughout. \# Rfishmorph

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Rfishmorph-data`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/Rfishmorph-data.md)
  : Bundled data

- [`add_fishmorph_species()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/add_fishmorph_species.md)
  : Append new species to a FISHMORPH table

- [`agreement_metrics()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/agreement_metrics.md)
  : Agreement metrics between two paired numeric vectors

- [`as_fishmorph_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/as_fishmorph_landmarks.md)
  : Coerce to fishmorph_landmarks

- [`as_intrait_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/as_intrait_landmarks.md)
  :

  Coerce to an intraitR `intrait_landmarks` object

- [`build_fishmorph_landmark_table()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/build_fishmorph_landmark_table.md)
  : Build the landmark-derived FISHMORPH trait table

- [`check_geometry_conventions()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/check_geometry_conventions.md)
  : Check the FISHMORPH digitizing conventions

- [`check_infinite_ratios()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/check_infinite_ratios.md)
  : Diagnose non-finite or extreme FISHMORPH ratios

- [`check_landmark_order()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/check_landmark_order.md)
  : Report vertical-ordering inconsistencies in landmarks (no
  correction)

- [`check_reconstruction_roundtrip()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/check_reconstruction_roundtrip.md)
  : Check the reconstruction round-trip

- [`compare_segments_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/compare_segments_landmarks.md)
  : Compare landmark-derived and published FISHMORPH measurements

- [`correct_geometry_conventions()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/correct_geometry_conventions.md)
  : Enforce the FISHMORPH digitizing conventions (optionally
  straightening)

- [`correct_landmark_order()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/correct_landmark_order.md)
  : Correct impossible vertical landmark orderings

- [`correct_zero_ratio_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/correct_zero_ratio_landmarks.md)
  : Apply the "zero-ratio" conventions to landmarks

- [`fishmorph_basin_indices()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_basin_indices.md)
  : Functional-diversity indices of one assemblage

- [`fishmorph_build_db()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_build_db.md)
  : Rebuild the DuckDB database from the journals

- [`fishmorph_consolidate()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_consolidate.md)
  : Rebuild the analysable table from the journals

- [`fishmorph_db_connect()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_db_connect.md)
  : Open the database (read-only by default)

- [`fishmorph_fishbase_size()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_fishbase_size.md)
  : Maximum standard length and weight from FishBase

- [`fishmorph_journal_qc()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_journal_qc.md)
  : Quick quality control of a consolidation

- [`fishmorph_landmark_pairs()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_landmark_pairs.md)
  : Segment -\> landmark-pair map

- [`fishmorph_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_landmarks.md)
  : Create a fishmorph_landmarks object

- [`fishmorph_ratio_names()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_ratio_names.md)
  : Names of the 9 FISHMORPH ratios

- [`fishmorph_ratios()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_ratios.md)
  : Compute the 9 FISHMORPH ratios

- [`fishmorph_reconstruction_defaults()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_reconstruction_defaults.md)
  : Default free parameters for landmark reconstruction

- [`fishmorph_schema()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_schema.md)
  : FISHMORPH digitizing scheme

- [`fishmorph_segment_names()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_segment_names.md)
  : Names of the 11 FISHMORPH segments

- [`fishmorph_segments()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_segments.md)
  : Compute the 11 FISHMORPH segments from landmarks

- [`fishmorph_space_data()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_space_data.md)
  : Path of the bundled FISHMORPH trait table

- [`fishmorph_trait_space()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_trait_space.md)
  : Build the FISHMORPH functional trait space

- [`fishmorph_traits()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_traits.md)
  : Full FISHMORPH trait table (segments + ratios)

- [`fishmorph_validate()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fishmorph_validate.md)
  : Structural AND morphometric control

- [`fm_journal_append()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_journal_append.md)
  : Append one record (one specimen) to the journal

- [`fm_journal_history()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_journal_history.md)
  : History of the records of one key

- [`fm_journal_open()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_journal_open.md)
  : Open a session journal (append-only)

- [`fm_journal_read()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_journal_read.md)
  : Read and concatenate every journal in a directory

- [`fm_journal_status()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_journal_status.md)
  : State of the journals in a directory

- [`fm_save_workbook_atomic()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/fm_save_workbook_atomic.md)
  : ATOMIC write of an openxlsx workbook

- [`freshwater_fish_list()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/freshwater_fish_list.md)
  : Build a global list of freshwater fishes

- [`group_colors()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/group_colors.md)
  : Look up the species colours used by the ordination plots

- [`impute_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/impute_landmarks.md)
  : Impute missing (NA) landmark coordinates

- [`impute_traits()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/impute_traits.md)
  : Impute missing values in a segment / ratio table

- [`is_fishmorph_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/is_fishmorph_landmarks.md)
  : Test whether an object is a landmark configuration

- [`launch_fishmorph_basins()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/launch_fishmorph_basins.md)
  : Global drainage-basin explorer

- [`launch_fishmorph_digitizer()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/launch_fishmorph_digitizer.md)
  : Interactive tool for digitizing the FISHMORPH landmarks

- [`launch_fishmorph_reconstructor()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/launch_fishmorph_reconstructor.md)
  : Launch the reconstruction tool (deprecated)

- [`launch_fishmorph_space()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/launch_fishmorph_space.md)
  : Morphological space explorer for freshwater fishes

- [`load_fishmorph_phylo_axes()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/load_fishmorph_phylo_axes.md)
  : Precomputed phylogenetic PCoA axes for the FISHMORPH species pool

- [`load_fishmorph_phylogeny()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/load_fishmorph_phylogeny.md)
  : Bundled global fish phylogeny

- [`load_fishmorph_reference()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/load_fishmorph_reference.md)
  : Load the FISHMORPH reference database

- [`new_fishmorph_species()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/new_fishmorph_species.md)
  : Create a FISHMORPH record for a new species

- [`phylo_pcoa()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/phylo_pcoa.md)
  : Phylogenetic Principal Coordinates Analysis

- [`plot(`*`<fishmorph_projection>`*`)`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot.fishmorph_projection.md)
  : Plot specimens projected into the global FISHMORPH space

- [`plot_functional_space()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot_functional_space.md)
  : Plot species in the FISHMORPH functional space (landmark- or
  segment-based)

- [`plot_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot_landmarks.md)
  : Plot a digitized / reconstructed fish

- [`plot_segment_landmark_agreement()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot_segment_landmark_agreement.md)
  : Plot landmark-vs-published agreement

- [`plot_trait_distributions()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot_trait_distributions.md)
  : Distributions of the FISHMORPH traits

- [`plot_trait_space()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/plot_trait_space.md)
  : Plot the FISHMORPH functional trait space (intraitR style)

- [`prepare_fishmorph_basins()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/prepare_fishmorph_basins.md)
  [`print(`*`<fishmorph_basin_cache>`*`)`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/prepare_fishmorph_basins.md)
  : Build the cache read by the basin explorer

- [`project_fishmorph()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/project_fishmorph.md)
  : Project specimens into the global FISHMORPH functional space

- [`read_landmarks_csv()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/read_landmarks_csv.md)
  : Read digitized landmarks from a CSV file

- [`reconstruct_fishmorph_landmarks()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/reconstruct_fishmorph_landmarks.md)
  : Reconstruct the 21 FISHMORPH landmarks from segments

- [`reset_group_colors()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/reset_group_colors.md)
  : Reset the session-level species colour cache

- [`set_fishmorph_source()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/set_fishmorph_source.md)
  [`get_fishmorph_source()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/set_fishmorph_source.md)
  : Choose the FISHMORPH measurement campaign for the session

- [`standardize_geometry()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/standardize_geometry.md)
  : Standardize landmark geometry (rescale, translate, optionally
  orient)

- [`summary(`*`<fishmorph_comparison>`*`)`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/summary.fishmorph_comparison.md)
  : Summary of a segment-versus-landmark comparison

- [`update_fishmorph_taxonomy()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/update_fishmorph_taxonomy.md)
  : Update the taxonomy of a FISHMORPH table

- [`validate_species_names()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/validate_species_names.md)
  : Validate and resolve species names against FishBase

- [`write_landmarks_csv()`](https://funtraits.github.io/Rfishmorph/reference/write_landmarks_csv.md)
  : Write landmarks to a CSV file (long layout)
